name: clawdy
description: Claude Code plugins worth open-sourcing. Small, opinionated tools that do one job.

plugins.name: mvp-kit
plugins.description: AI generators build the app. This puts it under CI, tests the security rules they wrote, and sets up backups.

plugins.name: adhd
plugins.description: Shape every reply for a reader with ADHD and explain it like they are new to the topic: next action first, numbered steps, zero jargon, and never cutting the context needed to understand it.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a handoff document that lets a fresh session resume work without re-discovering context, with failed attempts recorded so nobody walks the same dead end twice.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Statusline showing model, context use and token counts — with cost shown on Bedrock and DeepSeek, where you are actually billed per token.

plugins.name: devloop
plugins.description: Work a GitHub backlog unattended without stalling: prove a PR is actually mergeable before asking for review, poll for CI success because it is never evented, and reply to review threads only after the fix is pushed.

plugins.name: opinionated-claude
plugins.description: Install working conventions into your CLAUDE.md: act autonomously instead of asking permission to push, keep private infrastructure detail out of public repositories, keep changes surgical, and never claim something is verified without evidence.

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Deprecated — merged into `pm`. Install `pm` and uninstall this; the commands no longer ship here.

plugins.name: north-star
plugins.description: Agree a goal with a human, write it down, get it approved, then work towards it unattended on a heartbeat — using the issue tracker as the job queue and stopping when the goal is provably met.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Project management for an unattended loop: file work and ask questions without blocking, then order what comes back — a deterministic queue by severity, priority and how much each item unblocks.
